DECLARE @CURRENT_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @CURRENT_BUSINESS_DAY=FULLDATE
FROM 
    EDS.EDS_CTL ECT
INNER JOIN 
    EDS.DATE_DIM DD
    ON 
    ECT.CCD_DATE=DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AND DD.BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y';

	ON

	AND CA.AS_OF_DATE = @CURRENT_BUSINESS_DAY
LEFT JOIN
	EDS.CCD_CARDS CARDS
	ON
	CA.CRDACCT_NBR = CARDS.CARD_ACCT_NBR
	AND CA.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = CARDS.CARD_CUST_NBR
	AND CA.AS_OF_DATE = CARDS.AS_OF_DATE

	EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CD
	ON
